thresholds.rationale: The default min_header_delay is 1 s. A vote p99 of 1 s or less keeps votes inside one header interval and far below the 5 s vote_timeout.
The default max_header_delay is 2.5 s. An epoch record p99 of 2.5 s or less stays inside one header interval and below the 10 s request timeout.
A shed vote or epoch record request fails without a response, and the requester gets a stream error. The candidate must shed none in all phases.
The candidate sets process_budget. Established connections must not be more than the swarm allocation in any sample.
Hostile traffic must increase connection limit rejections. At the last sample, established connections must be at or below the steady peak for each swarm.
The candidate must keep at least 95 percent of the baseline block rate. The block rate comes from eth_blockNumber polls.
From the same state, the candidate catch-up time must be at most 110 percent of the baseline catch-up time.
Peak process RSS must stay at or below half of host RAM. The remainder is headroom for execution, storage and other servers.
Process CPU p95 must stay at or below 75 percent of host CPUs. Record the network share separately from a profiler trace.
